Keep Desk customers, contracts and CRM records in sync.

Give your agents a complete view of every customer with a two-way data-sharing integration between Desk and CRM.
Keep one customer database: contacts and accounts stay in sync both ways — custom fields included — and CRM deals come over as Desk contracts.
See CRM information such as deals, notes and activities in the same window as the ticket, contact or account.
Keep CRM users in the loop: mention them on tickets, and let contact owners know when their customers' tickets are created, answered or escalated.
Control who can see CRM data in Desk with profile-based permissions.
